basics.name: William Kirschenman
basics.summary: Ph.D. Candidate in Operations Research at NC State University. U.S. Army Operations Research Analyst focused on 2-D bin packing and spatial optimization with multi-level prioritization frameworks.

work.company: The Research and Analysis Center (TRAC), Army Futures Command
work.summary: Led wargaming analysis and developed cloud-based tools for strategic planning.
highlights: Lead developer of TRAC’s VADR, a cloud-based tool for wargaming and data collection.
Led execution and analysis for AFC’s 2020 Capstone Wargame.
Planned and executed touchpoints and assessments for Project Convergence 22.

work.company: 2nd Infantry Brigade Combat Team, 4th Infantry Division
work.position: Company Commander, Brigade Engineer Plans Officer
work.summary: Commanded engineer companies and led brigade-level engineering plans.
highlights: Commanded two companies with $35 million in equipment combined.
Primary engineer planner for a brigade with 3,500+ Soldiers.
Planned construction in Afghanistan for the Train, Advise, Assist Command – South.

work.location: Camp Red Cloud, Republic of Korea
work.summary: Planned and synchronized engineer operations for the ROK–U.S. Combined Division.
Advised Afghan National Army engineers in combat and construction operations.
highlights: Implemented training programs leading to top IED detection rates in the corps.

work.summary: Managed operations and personnel in fixed and floating bridge engineering units.
highlights: Oversaw $20 million in equipment and led 64-Soldier platoon.

publications.name: The 2-D Bin Packing Problem with Multiple Levels of Prioritization: A Spatial Optimization Perspective
publications.summary: Submitted to European Journal of Operational Research (Under Review). Co-authored with Heese, H.S., Kay, M., King, R., McConnell, B.

publications.name: Automated Vessel Selection and Combat Load Planning
publications.summary: Vol 56, No 4, 58-61. Co-authored with McConnell, B., King, R.
